## 自 v0.1.5 以来
- chore(release): bump to 0.1.6 - fix(reveal): switch to the app when the slide starts, and cap the total slide time - refactor(animation): slide duration comes from the setting, not from how you moved the mouse
## 安装
下载 `Ledge-0.1.6.dmg`,双击打开,把 Ledge 拖到「应用程序」。
**首次打开请右键点图标 →「打开」**,不要双击。这个包是 ad-hoc 签名的,没有 Apple Developer ID 证书(需付费会员),Gatekeeper 会拦一次;选「打开」之后就能正常双击了。
首次启动会请求**辅助功能**权限 —— 移动别的 App 的窗口必须要它。授权后自动就绪, 不需要重启。
需要 macOS 15 或更新版本。
装到「应用程序」之后,以后的版本会**在应用内自动下载并安装**,不用再走这一遍。 更新频率在设置里改。
## 校验
``` shasum -a 256 -c Ledge-0.1.6.dmg.sha256 ```

## 自 v0.1.4 以来
- chore(release): bump to 0.1.5 - feat(update): tell the user as soon as an update is staged, not a week later - docs(update): pin down when immediateFocus is actually reachable - docs(update): correct the update path in SPEC; drop the premature dismissal hook

## 自 v0.1.3 以来
- fix(update): scheduled updates get a gentle status-bar reminder, not stolen focus - ci(release): re-sign with stable self-signed cert so TCC grants survive updates - chore(release): bump to 0.1.4; note why scanReportedFocus skips subrole - perf(probe): window enumeration moves off the AX lane to WindowServer reads - feat(probe): cross-validate AX window scan against CGWindowList (stage 1 of B) - fix(reveal): hand-off-induced activations skip the intent/scan chain - fix(app): install a main menu so Cmd+Q works in the settings window - fix(permissions): one grant button for screen recording, same shape as accessibility - fix(update): stop gating update checks behind accessibility permission
